data.title: Discover reusable assets through read-only MCP
data.summary: An existing authorized spatial catalog and an explicit project scope. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Claude Code connects to external tools through configured MCP servers.

prerequisites: An authorized Claude Code / Codex / existing Studio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: An existing authorized spatial catalog and an explicit project scope.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent asset inventory workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: An existing authorized spatial catalog and an explicit project scope. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Inspect available tool schemas and search the permitted catalog for an equivalent asset
Fetch one candidate's current hash, dimensions, provenance and supported material features
Use the existing delivery planner to identify remaining gates before generating anything

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned discover reusable assets through read-only mcp candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: The selected source hash matches the file handed to the consuming project
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Sintra publishes instructions and public JSON, not the user's private asset catalog or a hosted MCP endpoint.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: The existing private Studio adapter offers search_assets, get_asset and plan_delivery; do not expose its private catalog publicly.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me discover reusable assets through read-only mcp in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: An existing authorized spatial catalog and an explicit project scope. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Out-of-scope projects are denied; The selected source hash matches the file handed to the consuming project. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
